headline: Mexico President Sheinbaum Promotes 'Plan México' Strategy at APEC 2026 Summit
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum presented the Plan México economic blueprint to business executives at the APEC summit, emphasizing direct investment and social welfare expansion.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy and a primary manufacturing destination under regional nearshoring trends.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Promoting national investment plans to APEC executives aims to boost foreign direct investment.
